items.title: Approval of Merger scheme by Board of Directors of PFC and REC
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Power Approval of Merger scheme by Board of Directors of PFC and REC प्रविष्टि तिथि: 30 JUN 2026 9:28AM by PIB Delhi The Board of Directors of Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) and REC Limited (REC) approved the Scheme of Merger (Scheme) for merger of REC (Transferor Company) into PFC (Transferee Company) and their respective shareholders and creditors, …
